contentList.content: Free-Handling requires at least one slot free in both Melee and Ranged slots. A longsword and a hand-crossbow will give you Free-Handling. A longsword and a longbow will not.
Swapping your equipment in combat only costs a Reaction. Sometimes the best path forward is in your back pocket.
Withers can help you change your class for free. Don't be afraid to experiment!
Not wanting to loot every little thing? Heroes Feast can be cast once per Long Rest to gain an abundance of Camp Supplies.
Medium and Heavy armour can help reduce the damage you take. Physical damage is reduced by your Constitution Modifier, while Elemental damage is reduced by your Charisma.
While you are a "Priority Target", enemies will focus on dealing damage to you. Use this feature to tank damage and protect your allies!
Dying got you feeling down? Healing and tanking are both extremely effective. Try to maintain a balanced party.
You can adjust the health, stats, and resources of enemies in the Difficulty menu, or when starting a new save. Just click "Adjust Difficulty" at the bottom!
The amount of Hit Points a healing potion restores scales with your Proficiency Bonus.
Both the living and the dead have plenty to say, but corpses won't be inclined to speak to their killers.
Any class can use any piece of gear. Have a specific class fantasy in mind? You can build it!
Zetherists are capable of swapping between their guns without expending resources.
To keep their Rage going, Barbarians must score at least one kill or Critical Hit every three turns. Doing so will reset the duration of their Rage.
Bards gain a Climax ability after three turns of Performing in battle, which can trigger powerful effects! Toggling "The Sound of Silence" will allow you to Perform while taking other actions, too!
Cleric's have a 33% chance each turn to experience Divine Intervention from their god, granting them the ability to trigger powerful effects based on their subclass!
Want to be the worlds deadliest house cat? While assuming the form of a Wild Shape, you retain all passive effects from your equipped gear.
Fighters will regain Hit Points and a Superiority Dice every three turns. Keep an eye on their Second Wind duration!
Monks are capable of hitting significantly more often than most classes. Stack damage bonuses in order to take advantage of it!
Judge, jury, and executioner! Once per turn, landing a killing blow as a Paladin will restore a Crusader's Smite charge.
Rangers can summon an animal companion at any time. Each Ranger Companion has unique benefits and uses, so don't be afraid to swap them out regularly!
As a Rogue, you can trigger a Sneak Attack against enemies you have Advantage against, dealing significantly more damage. This can also trigger if your ally is standing nearby your target!
Get creative with Creationary! Sorcerers can use Creationary to exchange their Sorcery Points with their Spell Slots, and vice versa, as an equal exchange.
Do not hesitate to call upon your Warlock's Hematic Invocation. A surviving enemy can deal far more than 10% of your Hit Points in a single strike.
Playing a Wizard? Pay attention to your active conditions! The Scholarly Acumen you're granted each turn can grant you significantly more Spell Slots.
Regret a decision made several levels ago? Selective Respec allows you to revisit your character's earlier choices without rebuilding everything from scratch.
In the Respec menu, you can save your favourite character builds as presets, allowing you to revisit old strategies, or even share them with your friends!
Found the perfect appearance for your adventurer? Save it as a preset in the Magic Mirror so you can recreate that look with the click of a button!
Looking for a particular Spell? Search by name or sort your Spell lists to find the exact magic you need. You can even combine different sorting types!
HomeBrew's higher difficulty settings aren't for the faint of heart. Choose your battles carefully, or you may find yourself on the wrong side of a very short adventure.
Selecting Custom within the "Adjust Difficulty" menu allows you to adjust both yours and enemies' Hit Points, stats, and resources, to create your ideal challenge.
With a Scroll of Transmogrification, armour can take on another appearance while retaining its original protective properties.
A Scroll of Reversion can restore transmogrified armour to its original appearance. Sometimes the classics really are better.
Finding HomeBrew too easy? Go to the Difficulty menu and select "Adjust Difficulty" at the bottom. You'll find plenty of options to make things more harsh for yourself.
Sometimes the most effective character builds arise from combinations nobody had thought to try. Experiment, adapt, and discover what works for you as a player.
Most effects which increase your damage, bypass Resistances, or trigger on a killing blow, will not trigger when dealing damage to allies.
Want to play a heavily armoured caster? Or perhaps a lightly armoured warrior? HomeBrew removes class-based restrictions, allowing you to build around and play your own class fantasy.
Complete HomeBrew on Heroic difficulty in order to be welcomed into the Hall of Heroes! See the difficulty page while starting a new save for more info.
Completing HomeBrew on Deific difficulty will grant access to the Deific Pantheon. Think you've got what it takes to become a god? See the difficulty page while starting a new save for more info.
Offence may win battles, but defence wins wars. Damage reduction, healing, and protective abilities become increasingly valuable against more powerful enemies.
HomeBrew remembers your custom difficulty settings separately for each campaign. Your adventures can offer entirely different levels of challenge without affecting one another.
Don't underestimate the value of controlling your enemies. A creature that cannot act could be just the edge you need to win a fight.
The best character build isn't always the one that deals the most damage. Experiment with combinations of abilities, equipment, and tactics to discover what works best for you.
Prefer to walk your own path? Lone Wolf offers powerful bonuses to adventurers willing to face the dangers of Faerûn without a full party. Who needs companions when you can be an army of one?
Sometimes the best defence is a devastating offence. Eliminating a dangerous enemy before it can act may save more Hit Points than any healing spell could restore.
Don't overlook your Bonus Actions and Reactions! Many of HomeBrew's abilities are designed to make use of these resources, allowing you to accomplish far more in a single turn.
Two-Handed weapons pierce an enemies Damage Resistance. If an enemy is hardy, bring out the big guns!
Many traps and environmental hazards cause extreme damage to larger creatures. Any smaller creature unlucky enough to be in the way will be instantly killed.
Many status effects and conditions can remove an enemies ability to reduce damage with their armour. Shatter their defenses, then move in for the kill!
Critical Hits ignore a creatures Damage Resistance entirely. It wouldn't be very critical if it was halved, now would it?
